description.value: Field & Social is a Vancouver salad and bowl cafe chain co-founded in 2016 around the premise that salads can be a satisfying, crave-worthy main meal. The Dunsmuir location is one of several across the city, serving a menu developed with a dietitian and an internationally trained chef using locally sourced ingredients and scratch-made dressings. Online ordering and catering are available, making it a practical stop for a nourishing meal in the downtown core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Field & Social is an active multi-location salad and bowl cafe chain in downtown Vancouver with online ordering and catering. The OSM tag diet:vegetarian=only sharply conflicts with the website menu, which features chicken, bacon, and other meats prominently — only individual items carry vegan or GF labels. No bike infrastructure, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags beyond indoor_seating and outdoor_seating=no.
concerns: OSM tag diet:vegetarian=only conflicts with website menu, which prominently features chicken, bacon, and other meats; only individual menu items are labelled vegan or GF.
No phone number available in OSM or on website.
Multi-location chain; this OSM record covers the Dunsmuir location only — other locations (Yaletown, Mount Pleasant, Royal Centre) may warrant separate OSM records and directory entries.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active downtown Vancouver cafe with takeout and dietary options that could serve touring cyclists, but no bike parking, washroom, or water refill information is available to confirm any of the required WWC criteria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu marks individual items as vegan (Thai Peanut Satay), gluten free (Chicken Tostada, Beets Bowl, Soy Mushroom Miso Bowl), dairy free (Coconut Chicken), and plant-based option (Soy Mushroom Miso Bowl)
